title: About the project
description: This service was created as a space where people come together to preserve family memories and share the stories of their ancestors

steps.title: Sign up and start creating your story
steps.content: After signing in, you can add information about loved ones, upload photos and memorable moments, mark important dates, and build your family connections.

steps.title: Add relatives and merge your family trees
steps.content: Invite family members and combine multiple trees into one large genealogical tree.

steps.title: See the full picture of your family tree
steps.content: View your complete family structure, connections between generations, and important events in a clear visual format.

steps.title: Add information about deceased relatives
steps.content: Preserve the memory of ancestors: dates of life, biographies, photos, and stories.
